world.title: Beginning of the end of MAGA’: Neera Tanden
world.summary: Neera Tanden, president and CEO of the Center for American Progress, asserts that pragmatic populism and immigration reform indicate the decline of the MAGA movement. She emphasizes the need for Democrats to focus on delivering results for working-class Americans. Tanden is recognized as a significant figure in progressive politics, having collaborated with multiple Democratic administrations.

world.title: A Colorado single mother took her 10-year-old son to a water park as a surprise, but a truck towing an excavator caused a fatal crash on their way home, killing her; four years later, a jury awarded h
world.summary: A Larimer County jury awarded $65 million to the family of Megan Arneson, a Colorado single mother killed in a crash involving a truck towing an improperly loaded excavator. The incident occurred in 2022 while she was returning home from a water park with her 10-year-old son. The jury found the truck's loading negligent.

world.title: 13-year-old boy identified as fourth Indian killed in UAE road accident
world.summary: A 13-year-old boy has been identified as the fourth Indian victim in a multi-vehicle road accident in Fujairah, UAE, which resulted in 14 fatalities. The crash, involving 23 vehicles, occurred in the early hours of November 12, 2026. Additionally, 30 people sustained injuries, and authorities have initiated an investigation into the circumstances surrounding the incident.

business.title: 12 NBFCs lose Rs 65 crore to cyber fraud in Delhi-NCR
business.summary: Twelve non-banking financial companies (NBFCs) in Delhi-NCR lost Rs 65 crore to cyber fraud. Hero FinCorp was notably affected, losing Rs 12 crore through 300 transactions on August 17. Police reported a new fraud pattern where hackers accessed NBFC systems to identify approved loans awaiting disbursement, subsequently diverting the funds before customers could receive them.

business.title: Jensen Huang seeks return as Nvidia CEO days after resignation
business.summary: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is reportedly seeking to return just four days after his resignation. Major investors, employees, and prominent tech leaders are urging the board to reinstate him. Petitions from employees and shareholders are gaining traction, reflecting significant support for Huang's potential comeback. Discussions about ways to reclaim his position are reportedly underway.

business.title: Indian chip startup Bharat Semi lands $24M seed round as it eyes global AI sensor market
business.summary: Indian semiconductor startup Bharat Semi has raised $24 million in seed funding to advance its AI-enabled image sensor technology. The company aims to secure design wins with clients, including General Atomics, and target the global AI sensor market. Founded nearly five years ago, Bharat Semi is currently pre-revenue and focuses on expanding its customer base in the U.S. and beyond.

technology.title: Your Windows 11 work laptop can now be locked remotely, and no password, PIN or admin account can get you back in, only IT can
technology.summary: Microsoft is testing a Remote Lock feature for Windows 11, allowing IT departments to block sign-in on lost or stolen work laptops through Intune. This method prevents unauthorized access without requiring a password, PIN, or admin account. The feature aims to enhance security by avoiding the need to wipe the device, preserving user files in the process.

technology.title: Xbox Reveals Original and 360 Boot-Up Options for 25th Anniversary
technology.summary: Microsoft has introduced three nostalgic boot-up options for the Xbox Series X/S and Xbox One, celebrating the brand's 25th anniversary. These options feature sounds and visuals reminiscent of the original Xbox and Xbox 360 consoles. The update aims to evoke fond memories for long-time fans of the Xbox gaming community, enhancing the gaming experience with a touch of nostalgia.

technology.title: How to Get Your PS5 and Xbox Ready for GTA 6 Launch
technology.summary: As the release of Grand Theft Auto 6 approaches, console owners are encouraged to prepare their PlayStation 5 or Xbox Series X and S. This preparation includes ensuring sufficient storage space, updating system software, and optimizing settings for the best gaming experience. With the launch imminent, gamers are advised to take these steps to enhance their gameplay upon release.

sports.title: Worst ever! Rohit Sharma ends New Zealand series with unwanted career record
sports.summary: Rohit Sharma had a disappointing performance in the ODI series against New Zealand, achieving the lowest batting average of his career as an opener in a bilateral series. He scored only 30 runs across the matches, marking a significant downturn in form for the former India captain. This series has been particularly challenging for Sharma's batting statistics.

sports.title: Cucurella and Huijsen feature as Spain surrender Nations League group lead to England
sports.summary: Spain faced England in a Nations League match at the Metropolitano, marking their first home game since winning the World Cup. Despite a festive atmosphere, Spain surrendered their group lead after the loss. Marc Cucurella played the full 90 minutes, while central defender Jay Huijsen contributed for 45 minutes. Spain's previous five-game winning streak came to an end.

sports.title: Jude Bellingham delivers another assist in England’s win over Spain
sports.summary: Jude Bellingham provided an assist in England's victory over Spain, contributing significantly during his 83 minutes on the field. In contrast, Trent Alexander-Arnold did not participate in the match. The game showcased Bellingham's growing influence in the team, while England's performance highlighted their strength against a competitive opponent. The match results reflect England's continued success in international football.

health.title: As diabetes spikes in Kashmir, the health lens turns to the fabled wazwan
health.summary: Diabetes cases are rising in Kashmir, attributed to rice-heavy diets, lavish wazwan feasts, and sedentary winter lifestyles, according to Diabetes Simplified for Kashmir. The traditional wazwan, featuring dishes totaling 4,500-5,500 calories, plays a significant role in this health crisis. Experts emphasize the cultural importance of these meals while highlighting their contribution to increasing diabetes prevalence in the region.

health.title: Beyond weight loss, GLP-1 medicines found to offer heart, kidney and brain health benefits
health.summary: GLP-1 drugs, initially created for diabetes management and now popular for weight loss, are demonstrating additional health benefits. Clinical trials and real-world evidence suggest positive impacts on cardiovascular, kidney, brain, and liver health. However, medical professionals emphasize that these medications should be used only under appropriate medical supervision to ensure safety and effectiveness in treating various health conditions.

health.title: Hashimoto’s thyroiditis: why symptoms can persist even after thyroid levels normalise
health.summary: Hashimoto’s thyroiditis can lead to ongoing symptoms like fatigue, hair loss, and weight fluctuations, even after thyroid hormone levels return to normal. Rashmi Ramesh, 40, from Mumbai, has managed the condition for nearly two decades and still experiences these issues. Despite her diagnosis at age 20, symptoms such as puffiness and weight changes persist, complicating her management.

science.title: Space dust points to an ancient water reservoir beyond Neptune
science.summary: Twelve grains of space dust collected above Earth provide evidence of ancient water enriched in rare forms of oxygen from the Kuiper Belt. The grains exhibit radiation tracks indicating their origin beyond Neptune. Additionally, clay minerals found within the dust offer insights into cold water-rock reactions, suggesting a historical reservoir of water in this distant region of the solar system.

science.title: Astronomers redefine star cluster in a new study
science.summary: Astronomers have redefined the star cluster UBC 63, previously thought to be a single entity. Utilizing Gaia data, researchers discovered that UBC 63A and UBC 63B are two distinct clusters with differing ages, formed after a close encounter. This finding, from a collaborative team of Indian and international astronomers, enhances understanding of star cluster formation and evolution.

science.title: Scientists have drawn a ‘treasure map’ of where fossils of ancient sea life are still waiting to be found, after mapping 540 million years of records, and the richest untapped finds may be the younges
science.summary: Scientists have created a detailed map indicating potential locations of ancient sea life fossils, based on 540 million years of geological records. The research suggests that the richest, untapped fossil finds may be located in younger geological formations. This new map aims to guide future paleontological explorations, highlighting areas where significant discoveries could still be made.

entertainment.title: Horoscope Today: November 16, 2026
entertainment.summary: On November 16, 2026, Scorpios are advised to embrace transition rather than holding on to the past. This week emphasizes the importance of letting go of what no longer serves them. While it may be challenging, recognizing the need for change is essential. The horoscope suggests that Scorpios should focus on personal growth and moving forward.

entertainment.title: Meet the Iranian diplomat behind viral Bollywood memes
entertainment.summary: Iranian diplomats in Delhi are leveraging Bollywood songs, dialogues, and pop culture to connect with a global audience amid the West Asia conflict. Their creative approach includes satirical content featuring iconic Bollywood characters, such as Hrithik Roshan’s Krrish. This strategy aims to engage and resonate with the Indian audience while addressing serious issues in a lighthearted manner.

entertainment.title: Pisces Horoscope Today: November 16, 2026
entertainment.summary: On November 16, 2026, Pisces individuals are encouraged to connect with their inner voice and intuition as the full moon approaches. Recent influences from the new moon have sparked ideas, goals, and insights. New responsibilities may arise, offering opportunities for growth. It is a time to embrace these changes and focus on personal development and aspirations.
